captions.detailed: A student monocular microscope featuring a thick, black rectangular base and a curved vertical support arm. It includes a light-gray slide stage equipped with a slide holder carriage, a revolving nosepiece with three objective lenses (one highlighted in gold, others in black), and a monocular eyepiece tube pointing upward. The optical head slides vertically along a dual-rail guide system on the arm, the nosepiece rotates continuously, and a slender diaphragm lever pivots horizontally beneath the stage.
captions.instruction: Create a classroom-scale monocular microscope with a black rectangular base, a curved rear support column, and a light-gray specimen stage. Implement a vertical sliding adjustment for the optical head assembly, a rotating objective turret with three lenses, a sliding slide holder on the stage, and a pivoting diaphragm lever underneath.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a large rectangular box and the vertical column using extruded curved profiles. Model the stage as a flat rectangular plate with a smaller sliding block representing the slide carriage. Build the optical head with a cylindrical eyepiece tube attached to a rectangular block, and mount a cylindrical nosepiece holding three small cylinders for the objectives. Define prismatic joints for the vertical head movement and stage carriage, a continuous joint for the rotating nosepiece, and a revolute joint for the thin cylindrical diaphragm lever beneath the stage.
